name: How much does it cost to build a detached ADU in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a detached ADU in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to build a detached ADU in Orange County can vary significantly based on factors like size, design complexity, materials chosen, and site conditions. Expenses typically include permits, architectural plans, foundation work, framing, utilities connections, and interior finishes. While precise costs require a detailed estimate, homeowners should budget for a substantial investment, often ranging from several tens of thousands to over a hundred thousand dollars, depending on the scope.
